home.text: FRAMES Sign in WELCOME TO 24 FRAMES Stories made close to home. Films, series, music and live events from Botswana and across Africa. Sign in with your phone number or email to start watching, here or in the 24 Frames app. Sign in to watch Read our policies ON 24 FRAMES Four ways in, one account. Films and series Start on your phone and finish on your computer, right where you left off. Music Songs and music videos, with a player that keeps going while you look around. Live Events streamed as they happen, and a schedule of what is coming up. Shorts Short videos from creators, one after another, made for a phone. OPEN TO EVERYONE Our policies, before you sign in How 24 Frames handles your data, what you agree to, and how to reach us. No account needed to read any of them. Privacy Policy What 24 Frames collects, why it is collected, and the choices you have. Terms of Service The agreement between you and 24 Frames when you watch, sign in or take part. Community Guidelines How to take part in Shorts, live streams and channels without harming others. Content Policy What may be published on 24 Frames, what is restricted, and what is removed. Creator Terms The rights you grant, the rights you must hold, and what you promise when you publish. Copyright and Takedown How to report infringement, and how takedowns and counter-notices are handled. Advertising Policy What advertisers may run, where ads appear, and how they are labelled.
